propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeConductorSegment
propertySets.definition: An electrical conductor is a single linear element with the specific purpose to lead electric current. The core of one lead is normally single wired or multiwired which are intertwined. According to IEC 60050: IEV 195-01-07, a conductor is a conductive part intended to carry a specified electric current.

properties.name: CrossSectionalArea
properties.definition: Cross section area of the phase(s) lead(s).

properties.name: Function
properties.definition: Type of function for which the conductor is intended.

properties.name: ConductorMaterial
properties.definition: Type of material from which the conductor is constructed.

properties.name: Construction
properties.definition: Purpose of informing on how the vonductor is constructed (interwined or solid). I.e. Solid (IEV 461-01-06), stranded (IEV 461-01-07), solid-/finestranded(IEV 461-01-11) (not flexible/flexible).

properties.name: ConductorShape
properties.definition: Indication of the shape of the conductor.

properties.name: NominalCurrent
properties.definition: The nominal current that is designed to be measured.

properties.name: ACResistance
properties.definition: The resistance under AC.

properties.name: ThermalExpansionCoefficient
properties.definition: Quantity characterizing the variation with thermodynamic temperature T of the distance l between two points of a body, under given conditions (IEC 113-04-27). The ratio is defined per Kelvin.

properties.name: CurrentCarryingCapacity
properties.definition: Maximum value of electric current which can be carried continuously by a conductor, a device or an apparatus, under specified conditions without its steady-state temperature exceeding a  specified value. Based on IEC60826-11-13. NOTE: The temperature specified value is maximum Design Ambient Temperature.

properties.name: UltimateTensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum stress that a material or element can withstand before breaking while being stretched or pulled.

properties.name: MassPerLength
properties.definition: Mass per length, i.e. mass of a beam with a unit length of extrusion. For example measured in kg/m.

properties.name: TensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

properties.name: YoungModulus
properties.definition: A measure of the Young's modulus of elasticity of the material.

properties.name: DCResistance
properties.definition: The resistance under direct current and 20 degrees centigrade.

properties.name: OverallDiameter
properties.definition: The overall diameter of a object.

properties.name: NumberOfCores
properties.definition: The number of cores.

properties.name: RatedVoltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

propertySets.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeEarthingConductor
propertySets.definition: Properties of earthing conductors used in overhead contact line systems. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type CONDUCTORSEGMENT.

properties.name: ResistanceToGround
properties.definition: The resistance through earthing conductor to the ground. Real part of the impedance to earth [SOURCE IEC: 195-01-18]

propertySets.name: Pset_ElectricalFeederLine
propertySets.definition: Properties of conductors used as feeder line. This property set is applicable to a type or occurrence of IfcCableSegment with predefined type CONDUCTORSEGMENT.

properties.name: CurrentCarryingCapacity
properties.definition: Maximum value of electric current which can be carried continuously by a conductor, a device or an apparatus, under specified conditions without its steady-state temperature exceeding a  specified value. Based on IEC60826-11-13. NOTE: The temperature specified value is maximum Design Ambient Temperature.

properties.name: DesignAmbientTemperature
properties.definition: The highest and lowest local ambient temperature likely to be encountered.

properties.name: ElectricalClearanceDistance
properties.definition: The distance between two conductive parts along a string stretched the shortest way between these conductive parts. (IEV ref 441-17-31)

properties.name: ElectricalFeederType
properties.definition: Type of electrical feeder.
